amanda_cs: FYI Maple & Co returned the vendor risk form and asked for SOC2 evidence + DPA. They also want clarification on region pinning and KMS support.
eli_maple: Thanks Amanda — attached questionnaire. Two big asks: (1) Can data/embeddings be restricted to eu-west-1? (2) Do you support customer-managed keys for Hosted? Need timeline for evidence for procurement.
sara_security: We can provide SOC2 Type II and a signed DPA. Short answer on KMS: customer-managed keys are supported for Dedicated/Private today; Hosted BYOK is on the roadmap. I'll paste a quick snippet.
sara_security: ```json
{"kms_supported_deployments": ["dedicated", "private"], "hosted_byok_eta": "Q3-2025"}
```
thomas_eng: For Dedicated we can pin to eu-west-1. Need an infra reservation — @amanda_cs can you confirm expected peak qps so we can size the GPU pool?
amanda_cs: Customer expects ~20 req/s peak, mostly short chat streams. Renewal is 2025-06 — I'll flag as medium renewal risk until DPA signed. I'll schedule a QuickStart enablement next week to walk through keys + region setup.
eli_maple: Also want a short onboarding runbook for keys + region pinning and a replay of the PLG onboarding demo for the product team.
sara_security: Runbook excerpt:```bash
# Create CMK in eu-west-1
aws kms create-key --description "Maple & Co CMK" --region eu-west-1
# Update deployment (example)
redwoodctl deploy --deployment maple-private --kms-key-id <CMK_ID> --region eu-west-1
```
amanda_cs: I'll bundle artifacts (SOC2 cert, signed DPA template, runbook, regional capacity doc). ETA: EOD Thursday.
thomas_eng: Opening infra ticket INF-2219 to reserve GPUs in eu-west-1 and reference this thread.
deploy_bot: Ticket INF-2219 created by thomas_eng — https://redwood.internal/tickets/INF-2219 :white_check_mark:
eli_maple: One more: question 12 on retention was ambiguous — I'll send annotated feedback after review.
amanda_cs: Noted. Actions: (1) amanda assemble artifacts (EOD Thu), (2) thomas open infra ticket (INF-2219 created), (3) sara provide final signed DPA (by Tue). Renewal risk stays at medium until DPA signed. :thumbsup:
